seo.title: L'Oreal SkinConsult AI: selfie-based skin diagnosis - up to 70% purchase, 56 countries (2024)
seo.meta_description: L'Oreal's AI skin diagnosis (SkinConsult AI / ModiFace) is deployed in 56 countries across 7 brands, with up to 70% purchase after the experience.
seo.resume_citable: L'Oreal's AI skin diagnosis (SkinConsult AI, ModiFace engine) is deployed in stores in 56 countries across 7 brands, with up to 70% of consumers buying after the experience.

faq.a: A selfie is compared against L'Oreal's Skin Ageing Atlases image database to score signs of ageing and propose a personalized product routine.

faq.q: What is the reported commercial impact?
faq.a: Up to 70% of consumers buy after the diagnostic experience, deployed in stores in 56 countries across 7 brands according to L'Oreal's annual report.

pattern: AI diagnosis from a selfie plus routine recommendation
objectif_business: Turn a selfie into a personalized skin diagnosis and product routine, to steer online and in-store purchase and lift conversion.
description: SkinConsult AI analyzes a selfie to assess signs of skin ageing (wrinkles, spots, pores, firmness) through a comparative algorithm trained on L'Oreal's Skin Ageing Atlases image database, then proposes a suitable product routine. The technology, powered by ModiFace, feeds the skin diagnosis of the group's brands (Vichy, La Roche-Posay, L'Oreal Paris) on their sites, in stores, and on Tmall in China. In 2024, L'Oreal reports providing skin diagnosis and routine in stores in 56 countries across seven of its brands.
points_cles: AI skin diagnosis from a selfie, then product routine recommendation.
ModiFace / SkinConsult AI engine, trained on the 6,000-image Skin Ageing Atlases dataset.
Up to 70% purchase after the experience, deployed in stores across 56 countries via 7 brands.
Evidence B, confirmed status: documented in L'Oreal's 2024 annual report.

resultats.metrique: Purchase rate after the diagnostic experience
Clinical images from L'Oreal research used for the diagnosis program

niveau_preuve.justification: Conversion figure and market coverage published in L'Oreal's official annual report (primary source), technology described by established press and by the brand. Concordant sources, one of them primary.

stack_technique.detail: diagnosis of skin ageing signs (wrinkles, spots, pores, firmness) from a selfie, with routine recommendation
computer vision engine (L'Oreal subsidiary) that powers the diagnosis for the group's brands
proprietary L'Oreal database of 6,000 graded images used as a comparative reference for the algorithm
distribution channel for the diagnosis in China, in addition to brand sites and in-store kiosks

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: On demand (one analysis per selfie), continuously available online and in store
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Beauty Tech / ModiFace team for the engine, brand teams and in-store advisors for usage
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The quality and representativeness of the reference image database (Skin Ageing Atlases). A biased or too narrow training set degrades the diagnosis for certain skin phototypes.

etapes.detail: The user uploads a selfie on the brand site or in store.
The algorithm compares the face against the graded image database and scores signs of ageing.
The system returns a diagnosis and a personalized product routine.
The advisor (store) or the page (web) steers the customer toward buying the recommended products.
The teams update the image database and the diagnosis-to-product mapping.

prerequis_data: graded and diverse reference image database
prerequis_orga: dermatology/data expertise for training and validation
site integration plus training of in-store advisors
replication.equipe: 1 PM + 1-2 vision data scientists (custom path) + 1 dermatology/domain expert + legal for facial data

playbook.action: Build or license a graded and diverse reference image database, and frame compliance (consent, non-retention of the image, non-medical nature of the diagnosis)
playbook.livrable: Validated reference dataset + GDPR impact assessment

playbook.action: Define the diagnosis-to-product and routine mapping with domain experts
Train the classification model or integrate a skin-analysis SaaS, then validate accuracy across varied phototypes
playbook.livrable: Prototype with error rate measured by phototype

playbook.action: Integrate the selfie, diagnosis, then routine journey on the site and in a store pilot, with advisor training
playbook.livrable: Journey in production on one market + trained advisors

playbook.action: Measure the post-diagnosis purchase rate and extend to other brands and markets

replication.premiere_etape: Build or license a validated reference image database and define the diagnosis-to-product mapping before any deployment.

statut_vivant.note: AI skin diagnosis generalized at group scale (56 countries, 7 brands) according to the 2024 annual report.

transposable_ue.note: Diagnosis from a selfie: the face image is personal data (potentially sensitive depending on use). Require explicit consent, minimization and non-retention of the image, and clear transparency about the non-medical nature of the diagnosis (GDPR, AI Act).
